notes: Item 19 discloses Net Royalty Sales (as defined in Item 6, Note 1) for 997 Marco's Pizza franchised stores open for the full 52-week fiscal year ending December 28, 2025. Data excludes: international locations (including Puerto Rico), 58 new stores not open for the full 52-week period, special venue locations, Hoogland Foods/Family Video locations, and 28 stores that closed in 2025. Financial information was prepared by Marco's management and has not been compiled, reviewed, or audited by Marco's auditors. The top/bottom percentage cohorts are presented on both a category (non-cumulative tier) and cumulative basis per the document description; values extracted as presented in the tables. The 'Total' column figures are identical across both top and bottom tables (avg $878,180, median $832,403), confirming consistency.
